parts:
感謝Aaron大大
附件為data，還有下列是我的指令參考一下~

library(RadioSonde)

setwd("D:/R/skew-t")
data<-read.table("./taipei2.txt", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
filename <- "./taipei2.txt"
datakey  <- "------"
varkey   <- " PRESS"
unitkey  <- "  hPa"
sample.sonde <- getsonde(filename, datakey, varkey, unitkey)
names(sample.sonde)

attr(sample.sonde,"units")
a1<-attr(sample.sonde,"metadata")
a2<-a1[1:26]
a3<-strsplit(a2,":")
a<-data.frame()
for(i in 4:length(a3)){
  a4<-data.frame("Index"=gsub(" {2,}","",a3[[i]][1]),"Value"=as.numeric(a3[[i]][2]))
  a<-rbind(a,a4)
  a[2]<-round(a[2],1)
}
test<-c("SLAT",
        "SLON",
        "SELV",
        "SHOW",
        "LIFT",
        "LFTV",
        "SWET",
        "KINX",
        "CINX",
        "VINX",
        "TOTA",
        "CAPE",
        "CAPV",
        "CINS",
        "CINV",
        "BRCH",
        "BRCV",
        "LCLT",
        "LCLP",
        "MLPT",
        "MLMR",
        "THTK",
        "PWAT")
a$INDX.<-test
aa<-a[a[[2]]>0,]
zz<-paste(aa$INDX.,"=",aa$Value)

#plot

plotsonde(sample.sonde,title="WeatherRisk SKEW-T 2015/03/19 12Z",skewT=TRUE)
for(p in 1:17){
  c=-0.7*p
  mtext(text=zz[p],side=3,adj=-.2,cex=0.8,line=c)
}

#legend(x=5.5, y=44.1,legend=c("PWAT=32.06","THTK=5785","MLR=14.09","MLPT=295.84"),cex=.5,pt.cex=c(5,6,7,7))

windplot<-c(0.7,1,0.09,0.88)
par(plt=windplot,pty="s",new=TRUE)
plotwind(sample.sonde,size=0.6, ylim=c(1050,100),legend=TRUE)
